title: Efficient Best-Of-N with Radial Consensus Score
abstract: arXiv:2604.12196v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Solving complex problems with large language models (LLMs) often requires selecting the best answer from multiple candidate responses (best-of-$N$), yet identifying the most reliable one remains challenging, particularly when correctness does not align with majority agreement. Existing approaches based on voting or probability scoring rely on surface-level signals (e.g., frequency or token-level likelihood), often missing high-quality rare answers and ignoring the geometric structure of candidate representations, where correctness may emerge as semantic consistency rather than surface agreement. To address these limitations, we introduce Radial Consensus Score (RCS), a simple, efficient, and training-free method for best-of-$N$ selection. translated_title: 基于径向共识分数的高效Best-of-N选择方法
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型（LLM）解决复杂问题时，往往需要从多个候选回答中选出最佳答案（best-of-N），然而识别出最可靠的答案仍然具有挑战性，尤其是当正确性并不与多数意见一致时。现有的基于投票或概率评分的方法依赖于表层信号（如频率或词元级似然），常常遗漏高质量但罕见的答案，并且忽略了候选表示的几何结构——在这种结构中，正确性可能体现为语义一致性而非表面一致性。为解决这些局限，我们提出了径向共识分数，这是一种简单、高效且无需训练的best-of-N选择方法。RCS通过计算答案嵌入的加权Fréchet均值（语义中心）来建模语义共识，并根据候选答案到该中心的径向距离进行排序。这使得它能够恢复……
tldr: 提出径向共识分数（RCS），通过计算答案嵌入的加权Fréchet均值作为语义中心，并依据候选答案到该中心的径向距离进行排序，实现了一种简单、高效且无需训练的best-of-N答案选择方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Radial Consensus Score (RCS), a simple, efficient, and training-free best-of-N selection method that computes a weighted Fréchet mean (semantic center) of answer embeddings and ranks candidates by their radial distance to this center.
